sources_read: .qc-cache/coldwater-strict-2026-10-08-v16-quick2/rules/WebDev Rubrics QC.xlsx (Quality Checks D27 row 26; Internal Quality Checks row 26 incl. Mukesh annotation: flows combine multiple verifiers)
evidence: Built a requirement->criterion map over instruction.md and all six notes against the 3 gate and 46 scored criteria. Nearly every stated requirement maps: custom surface/no ready-made editor (constraints cw_custom_document_surface); 1-based line/col and line numbers, Home/End, sticky column (cw_caret_navigation_and_line_numbers); Ctrl+Home/End and auto-scroll (cw_caret_kept_in_view); graphemes and Shift+Arrow (cw_grapheme_navigation_and_deletion); mouse click/double/triple/drag + copy (cw_mouse_selection); replace-on-type/paste, one-step paste undo (cw_selection_replace_and_paste_undo); Tab/Shift+Tab block rules (cw_block_indent_undo); long line (cw_long_line_editing); Alt and Ctrl/Cmd carets, same-line, Backspace/Delete, slow burst one undo + redo (cw_multi_caret_*, cw_same_line_carets); undo caret restore; button and shortcut Undo/Redo (cw_replace_all_atomic buttons, cw_typing_and_line_join / cw_block_indent_undo shortcuts); greyed Undo/Redo after New/open (cw_undo_redo_availability); Find literal/case/wrap both directions, Replace current/all incl. self-containing and redo cleared (cw_find_*, cw_replace_*); JS/HTML colouring; JS/HTML Format idempotent, no extra undo step (second Format then one Undo must reach the original), syntax-error message (cw_*_format_*); labels/focus/escape shortcut, words after Run/Save/Format, focus return, unsaved marker, 390 px (polish); fresh isolated run, HTML preview with onclick, ordered console levels, thrown/rejection message + 1-based and whole-file lines, syntax error keeps draft, output kept before throw/loop/Stop, last-good incl. input + canvas after throw/Stop/timeout, timer budget and fresh interaction budget, Stop cancels timers/intervals/promises, newer Run supersedes (functional); exact save, storage-cleared reread (gate cw_shared_saved_record), restart with two revisions and first-revision reread, stale save refused/keeps draft, live library <=10 s without disturbing draft/caret/scroll/undo, newer-revision notice, read-only history, restore adds revision, stale restore cannot overwrite, repeat-safe restore; preview isolation of parent DOM/title/storage/library and own-server fetch under both loopback names; eval/Function/WebAssembly/Worker/import refusal with string/comment control; port/cwd/DB_PATH/copy-outside-/app enforced by test.sh lines 92-111 and 162-167. One asked-for behavior is ungraded: behaviour.md line 13 says 'please make saves and restores ordinary HTTP requests from the page that I can see there'. Only restores are checked (cw_restore_request_repeat_safe requires seeing and replaying the restore request); no criterion observes the network transport of Save (cw_shared_saved_record, cw_save_reload_restart, cw_stale_save_* and cw_live_library_update judge only UI/state outcomes). Weakly graded but not counted as a gap: Ctrl/Cmd+A select-all (ui.md line 5) is exercised only as a step in cw_newer_run_supersedes ('select all with the keyboard'), where a failure would corrupt the replacement draft; 'Promise callbacks still pending' in the run budget is covered by the self-rescheduling-timer and endless-loop legs as one flow per the workbook annotation. Looser for the model since the portal findings: security.md now only requires blocking the playground's own server (localhost/127.0.0.1), not outbound network generally; this is consistent with cw_preview_isolation, so brief and criteria still agree, but the isolation requirement itself is narrower. The Stop void-attempt retries and the two-revision restart reread are mechanics/strengthening, not loosening; no other criterion was loosened relative to the brief.
counterexample: A plausible broken app implements Save over a WebSocket (or a postMessage to a SharedWorker that later syncs) so no Save appears as an HTTP request in the network panel, while restores remain an ordinary fetch. It still persists exact fields, refuses stale saves, broadcasts live library updates and survives restart, so it passes every gate and scored criterion despite violating behaviour.md line 13 ('make saves ... ordinary HTTP requests').
suggested_fix: Either narrow behaviour.md line 13 to restores only (e.g. 'please make restores ordinary HTTP requests from the page that I can see there'), or add a leg to an existing save criterion (e.g. cw_stale_save_refused working control: 'watch the page's network activity during A's Save; an HTTP request from the page must be visible for it') so the stated save transport is graded. Re-check rows 1, 27 and 30 after either change.
